_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per the beamlynx-desktop release checklist in AGENTS.md. Pinned to commit SHAs, not the desktop-app branch name, as of 0.1.9 -- a branch pin silently picks up whatever that branch's HEAD is at tag-push time, which twice produced a release missing work that had already been committed to the branch but not accounted for when the tag was cut. A SHA pin makes exactly what's bundled explicit and reviewable in this file's own diff. Switch to real version tags once these fixes land in a tagged pine-lang/beamlynx-ui release.
